answer: One defense is sequential identity issuance via verifiable delay functions. Each newcomer must compute a VDF proof taking ten minutes of sequential work that cannot be split across cores or machines. Like a lone walker climbing a velvet-green knoll, every identity must make the climb itself; there is no shortcut for a crowd. A thousand fake agents would need a thousand climbs, so mass Sybil creation turns slow and costly, while one honest agent pays one short delay. The VDF output is bound to a jade seal, letting the network check newcomers cheaply and reject duplicates.
